name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.245: The cancellation now also carries the right time. 244 wrote the row through Finish(),
    which keeps an existing start because that is the real beginning of a run - the test bench then showed
    "cancel" next to a start three days old, since the column displays Started. A cancellation is not a
    run: MarkCancelled() stamps BOTH times with the moment of the stop, so the row reads "cancel" at the
    time it happened. The colour stays yellow like defer - the operator declined the grey change on
    19.10.2026, and the colour line is now pinned by T157 so it cannot drift.
